jobs.jobDescription:
Director, Influencer Strategy

LOCATION

The Director, Influencer Strategy position is a remote, work from home position, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. (a structure central to our culture and our vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, and conferences.

THE ROLE

Acceleration Partners is building out its influencer strategy discipline, and this role sits at the center of that effort. The Director, Influencer Strategy is a senior, externally-facing position responsible for shaping how AP goes to market with influencer programs. This person works at the intersection of sales, client services, and delivery, helping the business win new clients, build credible influencer strategies, and connect execution back to measurable outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings deep fluency in the brand-awareness and affiliate influencer space, strong business instincts, and the ability to work across internal teams to ensure that what we deliver compelling strategic programs that are successfully executed for our clients. A working knowledge of affiliate marketing is a plus; some learning curve on the affiliate side is expected and supported.

TOP 5 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

STRATEGY-LED SALES ENABLEMENT

Partners with the sales and delivery teams from the moment an opportunity comes in. Based on the prospect’s needs and goals, the Strategist owns building a credible, well-reasoned influencer strategy for proposals and RFPs. The Strategist will use thought-leadership and industry insights to define the appropriate creator strategy and the program’s direction – including audience insights, competitive analysis, creative positioning, influencer archetype creation, messaging frameworks, and platform recommendations. Works with delivery to ensure what is proposed is grounded in what can be delivered, budget, and scope. Joins pitch meetings alongside the sales lead and client services point person to speak to the strategy with authority and expertise. Answer client questions thoughtfully, showcasing a deep knowledge of the influencer space, examples of competitive programs, and creator best practices.

PROGRAM STRATEGY & INDUSTRY INTELLIGENCE

Define the strategy for robust, in-depth influencer programs grounded in industry research and competitive intelligence. Stays current on what brands across categories are doing in the influencer and affiliate space, tracking trends, emerging platforms, and talent ecosystems. Supports program launches and provides the strategic foundation that the delivery team executes against.

INDUSTRY LEADING REPORTING

Adds narrative and strategic context to reporting, connecting the dots between the strategy sold, the execution delivered, performance results, and forward-looking recommendations. Right now reporting is data-driven but lacks the strategic thread that ties it together. This role closes that gap and creates upsell opportunities in the process.

ONGOING CLIENT SUPPORT & UPSELL

Plugs in throughout the client lifecycle to provide strategic recommendations, industry thought-leadership, and pitching the strategy for expansion opportunities. Presents to clients alongside the delivery team on specialized program recommendations, optimizations, or expansions. Work on a diverse portfolio of brands, serving as a partner and resource to the delivery team and clients.

AP MARKETING & EXTERNAL PRESENCE

Contributes to AP’s external marketing through internal and external thought leadership. Opportunity to be featured in AP’s marketing efforts such as speaking at or attending conferences on influencer strategy topics. Helps build AP’s profile and credibility in the influencer space and inspire clients to believe in our strategic capabilities and knowledge base.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

BY 6 MONTHS...

You have a strong grasp of AP’s influencer offerings and sales process having contributed to multiple pitches. You are producing influencer strategy decks that the sales team is confident presenting to prospects. You have established working relationships with client services leads and understand how strategy translates into delivery. You are adding narrative context and future recommendations to client reports.

BY 1 YEAR...

You are a recognized internal resource for influencer strategy across the business. Your strategic program recommendations are being successfully delivered on with positive client feedback. The influencer pitch process runs more smoothly because of your involvement, and win rates on influencer opportunities are improving. Client reports have a cleaner strategic narrative and we see more clients opting into expansion opportunities. You are actively contributing to AP’s external presence through content or speaking, and you have identified and helped close at least one meaningful upsell opportunity.

QUALITIES OF THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • Brings a clear strategic point of view and can defend it in a room with senior clients and leadership
  • Equally comfortable building a deck and presenting it; thinks in narratives, but understands the tactics
  • Collaborative by instinct; understands that the best outcomes come from working across and with teams
  • Stays current on the influencer and creator space without being prompted; this is something they follow because they care about it in order to have a consistent pulse on the Influencer industry, brand activations, and social trends
  • Can operate with autonomy, ambiguity and ownership in a discipline that is still being built out
  • Reliable and able to effectively prioritize to hit deadlines
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, including with senior internal and external audiences
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, client-facing, agency environment working across multiple clients in different verticals

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • 7+ years of experience in influencer marketing, with meaningful exposure to strategy, program buildout, or new business
  • Demonstrated ability to build and present influencer strategies in a business development or client-facing context
  • Deep knowledge of the influencer and creator ecosystem across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Substack, and emerging channels
  • Working knowledge of affiliate marketing is a plus; willingness to learn is required
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to produce client-ready materials independently
  • Ability to synthesize and visualize information effectively independently or in collaboration with Design
  • Experience presenting to senior clients or speaking externally preferred
  • Bachelors degree required
  • Ability to travel as needed for client meetings, team gatherings, and industry conferences

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, AP’s global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that connect brands to the right consumers through affiliate and influencer All of our work is supported by APVision, our proprietary technology suite which leverages the largest dataset of any agency in the Partnership Marketing agency ecosystem. Serving over 200 brands—including household names like Amazon, Apple, Target, Google, Marriott, Coinbase, and Burberry—AP’s diversified team is creating what’s next in the industry by building high-performing partnership marketing programs. As the only truly integrated global partnerships agency, AP prides itself on being at the cutting edge of industry developments and leveraging proven expertise to deliver unique solutions for brands seeking sustainable growth.

AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER

  • 100% remote work for everyone
  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits)
  • 401K with matching
  • Open Paid Time Off
  • Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off
  • Focus Fridays
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!

Target base salary is $110-130K + bonus depending on location and experience.

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual’s age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.jobDescription:
About the team and role

Mozilla's Web Conferencing team owns the media capture and sharing features that make Firefox work for video calls: screen, window, and tab capture, and the interface users interact with when they share content in Google Meet, Zoom, or Jitsi.

We're bringing a set of screensharing improvements to Firefox. The backend work is complete and the UX has been designed and approved. We're looking for a front-end engineer on a fixed-term contract to implement it and ship it.

What you'll do

  • Implement approved UX designs for Firefox's screen, window, and tab sharing experience, and see them through to release
  • Build browser UI that holds up in a large, widely used codebase: tested, accessible, and localizable
  • Work with UX on the cases a design didn't anticipate, and with QA on validating the result
  • Support partner testing against major web conferencing services
  • Land your work in mozilla-central through public code review on Phabricator

What you'll bring

  • 4+ years building production user interfaces with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Experience implementing an approved design faithfully, plus the judgment to flag it when the design meets a case it didn't anticipate
  • Ability to get productive quickly in a large, mature codebase you didn't write
  • Experience writing automated tests for user interfaces
  • Strong asynchronous written communication, since the team is distributed across timezones
  • Comfort working in public, since Bugzilla and Phabricator are open

Bonus qualifications

  • Prior contributions to Firefox or another open-source browser
  • Familiarity with Firefox front-end architecture: browser/, custom elements, XUL, Fluent localization
  • Experience with WebRTC or getDisplayMedia
  • Accessibility experience with modal dialogs and list navigation
  • Experience with Mozilla's test frameworks (browser-chrome, mochitest)
  • Experience using AI tooling effectively in front-end development
  • Open source environment experience

Hiring Ranges:

Canada Tier 1 Locations

$145,000—$170,800 CAD

Canada Tier 2 Locations

$154,000—$168,000 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time, fully remote physician consultants who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across multiple U.S. states. Depending on your licensure, certification, and area of expertise, you will provide consultations in menopause and perimenopause care aligned to The Menopause Society and ACOG guidelines, early fertility support aligned to ACOG and ASRM guidelines, or both.

Metabolic health is a core, cross-cutting component of this program. Weight, insulin resistance, and cardiometabolic risk are central to outcomes across every journey we support, from ovulatory function and preconception readiness to menopausal symptom burden and long-term cardiovascular and bone health. You should expect metabolic assessment and management to be a routine part of your visits, and clinicians comfortable prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists, within clinical protocols are especially encouraged to apply.

This is a flexible, part-time contractor engagement of approximately 5-40 hours per week, with a target commitment of 10-15 hours per week.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Provide virtual consultations (video and/or phone) within your area(s) of expertise, including assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, and ongoing management of menopausal, fertility, and related hormonal and metabolic concerns.
  • Apply current ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines with individualized, shared decision-making.
  • Assess and manage metabolic health as a routine part of visits, including prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications such as GLP-1 receptor agonists within clinical protocols where appropriate.
  • Document visits accurately and on time, order and interpret relevant labs, and coordinate referrals to primary care, OB/GYN, endocrinology, behavioral health, or subspecialists as needed.
  • Maintain active, unrestricted multi-state clinical licensure, complete credentialing and payer enrollment, and maintain eligibility for additional state licenses to expand coverage.
  • Contribute to member experience and quality through strong virtual visit presence, effective use of telehealth and EHR systems, participation in chart audits and case reviews, and staying current with emerging research and regulatory changes.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a consistent panel of high-quality virtual visits within your clinical area(s), with strong member experience and visit quality results.
  • Maintained timely, accurate documentation and lab follow-up, with no outstanding credentialing or compliance gaps.
  • Expanded your state licensure coverage in line with program needs, supporting broader member access.
  • Integrated metabolic assessment and management, including GLP-1 protocols where clinically appropriate, as a routine part of your visits.
  • Contributed to chart audits, case reviews, and clinical protocol refinement as the telemedicine program scales.

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • An MD or DO in Obstetrics/Gynecology, Reproductive Endocrinology and Infertility (REI), Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or Endocrinology; or you are a Physician Assistant (PA) or Advanced Practice Registered Nurse/Nurse Practitioner (e.g., WHNP, adult/gerontology NP, FNP) with demonstrated expertise in the applicable clinical area.
  • A minimum of 3-5+ years of active clinical experience in early fertility support, menopause care, or both, including evaluation, treatment, and longitudinal management.
  • An active, unrestricted U.S. medical license; multi-state licensure is preferred and IMLC participation is strongly preferred.
  • For clinicians practicing in the menopause specialty: MSCP certification from The Menopause Society, or certification actively in progress with a clear completion plan.
  • Familiarity with ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines.
  • Prior telemedicine experience (preferred), with comfort managing visits entirely in a virtual environment and a strong virtual presence that supports shared decision-making over video and phone.
  • Proficiency with telehealth technologies, including video platforms, secure messaging, electronic prescribing, and EHR/clinical documentation tools.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and applicable telemedicine privacy, security, and regulatory requirements, along with a HIPAA-compliant home workspace and reliable internet.

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Clinical experience spanning both early fertility and menopause, enabling flexible coverage across member journeys.
  • Experience working in a dedicated menopause clinic, fertility center, or comparable specialty program.
  • Familiarity with early fertility workup, including AMH testing, ovulation induction, and preconception optimization, with appropriate escalation to in-person ART evaluation.
  • Experience prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists (titration, side-effect management, monitoring, and discontinuation planning); obesity medicine training or ABOM certification is a significant advantage.
  • Prior experience in digital health, health benefits, or multi-state telemedicine environments.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocol development, quality improvement, or member-facing clinical content.
  • Experience supporting diverse and historically underserved populations, including LGBTQ+ and gender-diverse individuals.
  • Fluency in an additional language.

Why This Role Matters

Carrot's telemedicine clinic is one of the most direct ways members experience our care. Every virtual visit shapes how members navigate some of the most personal moments of their lives, from trying to conceive to managing menopause. The clinicians in this network are the face of that experience, and the quality of their judgment, communication, and documentation determines whether members receive care they trust.

This role also anchors Carrot's clinical point of view that metabolic health is inseparable from reproductive and hormonal health. As the telemedicine program scales across states and journeys, the clinicians who join this network will directly expand access to guideline-aligned, whole-person care for members who often cannot find it locally.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $120-$160. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

jobs.jobDescription:
Director, Channel Partnerships

Location:

The Director, Channel Partnerships is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Candidates should be based in the U.S.

Role Purpose:

Acceleration Partners is seeking a commercially-minded Strategic Partnerships leader to build and grow a high-value agency partner ecosystem that generates measurable business growth. This role owns both the health of our existing strategic partnerships and the development of new relationships that create pipeline, revenue and market influence. Working across Sales, Marketing, Strategy and Client Services, this person will ensure partnerships become a scalable commercial growth channel rather than simply a network of relationships.

The Opportunity:

The role has two equally important priorities:
• Own and optimize AP's existing portfolio of strategic and technology partnerships, ensuring every relationship has clear objectives, governance and commercial value.
• Build new partnerships across adjacent ecosystems—including AI, retail media, social commerce, consultancies, agencies, technology providers and investors—that create new routes to market and commercial opportunity.

Success will be measured by pipeline generated, revenue influenced, strength of strategic relationships and the market intelligence brought back into the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Existing Partnership Management

  • Own AP's portfolio of strategic and vendor partnerships.
  • Implement a structured framework for partnership health, governance, renewals and executive engagement.
  • Identify underperforming relationships and create recovery plans.
  • Own referral routing and ensure opportunities progress through the commercial pipeline.

New Partnership Development

  • Identify and secure new strategic partners across adjacent markets.
  • Build executive relationships and create joint business plans, referral programmes and co-selling opportunities.
  • Identify when relationships should evolve into formal commercial agreements and support negotiations.
  • Continuously identify emerging partnership opportunities and strategic whitespace.

Commercial & Revenue Accountability

  • Own partner-sourced pipeline and revenue targets.
  • Measure both introductions created and commercial outcomes delivered.
  • Report performance and recommend investment priorities.

Cross-functional Leadership

  • Partner with Sales on target accounts, introductions and joint pursuits.
  • Work with Marketing on co-marketing, events, webinars and thought leadership.
  • Collaborate with Strategy and Client Services to ensure partner activity aligns with client needs and market opportunities.

Market Intelligence & External Representation

  • Represent AP at conferences and industry events.
  • Become a recognized industry voice within the partnership ecosystem.
  • Bring back competitor intelligence, AI developments, customer trends and partnership opportunities to influence strategy and propositions.

Skills & Experience:

  • 7+ years in partnerships, alliances, business development or related roles.
  • Services / consulting industry experience is preferred
  • Demonstrated ownership of pipeline and revenue targets.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of strategic partnerships.
  • Excellent executive relationship-building and communication skills.
  • Commercially minded with strong organizational discipline.
  • Experience in digital marketing, affiliate, retail media or marketing technology desirable.
  • Willingness to travel and represent AP externally.

Measures of Success:

  • Partner-sourced pipeline and revenue.
  • Health and commercial value of strategic partnerships.
  • New strategic partnerships established.
  • Joint go-to-market initiatives delivered.
  • Market intelligence adopted internally.
  • Brand visibility and industry influence.

Success in the First Year:

Within the first 90 days, develop a clear view of all existing partnerships, implement a governance framework and priorities improvements. Within the first year, establish new strategic relationships, convert opportunities into measurable pipeline and revenue, and create a sustainable operating rhythm between Partnerships, Sales, Marketing and Strategy.

AP Perks and Benefits:

  • 100% remote work for everyone
  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits)
  • 401K with matching
  • Open Paid Time Off
  • Summer and Holiday company-wide shutdown days in July and December
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off
  • Focus Fridays
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits
  • Wellness, Technology, and Education Allowances
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more

Salary: The target base salary range is $110-130K + commissions/incentive plan depending on location and experience.

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual’s age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.jobDescription:
We’re Capital on Tap
Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier.

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started!

The role starts out fully remote. Once our Lisbon office is open, it will move to a hybrid set-up of two days a week on site.

Salary: €65,000 - €75,000

Quality Engineering at Capital on Tap

Quality Engineering is embedded across our mission teams, partnering with Engineering, Product, and UX to champion quality at every stage of the software lifecycle. We build quality in from the start - not bolt it on at the end.

The Lead Automation Engineer is a critical, hands-on role embedded within a Mission team. Reporting functionally to your mission team’s Lead, you will be the quality champion for your specific feature set. You will leverage standardised automation tooling to maximise test coverage, accelerate delivery velocity, and maintain the highest quality standards for our products.

What You'll Be Doing ️

Mission Team Quality Ownership & Strategy

  • Define and own the comprehensive testing strategy for your domain (e.g., payments, banking, onboarding), ensuring end-to-end quality and compliance in partnership with the QA Team Lead.
  • Act as the primary contributor for automation; design, develop, and maintain robust automated tests (API, UI, Mobile).
  • Champion a "Shift-Left" mindset, working with Product Owners and Developers from the refinement stage to ensure quality is engineered in from the start.
  • Directly manage the mission team’s automation targets and use data-driven insights (MTTD/MTTR, defect escape rates) to predict high-risk areas.

Technical Leadership & Tooling Adoption

  • Serve as the mission team's expert on central automation frameworks, driving consistent adoption of CI/CD processes and quality gates.
  • Identify team-specific gaps and collaborate with the central Tooling Team to develop custom helpers or data generators that enhance the core framework.
  • Ensure automated test suites are fully integrated into CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, reliable deployment and a "fail fast" mechanism.
  • Coordinate complex technical testing, including microservices, security (OWASP ZAP), and performance testing.

Collaboration, Coaching & AI Innovation

  • Coach and upskill developers and junior QA engineers on automation best practices and test design patterns.
  • Champion the use of AI tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot) for complex tasks like architecture exploration, incident investigation, and test generation.
  • Leverage component testing, service virtualization, and contract testing to reduce dependencies and enable independent team testing.
  • Define test data strategies and environment requirements to support both automated and exploratory testing.

Our Values & Culture

  • Just Pilot: We never settle for “good enough”. We pilot new ideas fast, ask questions to figure it out, and scale quickly.
  • Why Not Today? Fast is as slow as we go - speed and simplicity gives us a competitive advantage.
  • Be a Buddy: We tap in from day one to help the team, we do the right thing even if it’s hard.
  • Owners and Dates: We don’t chase people. If you own a task and agree to a date, the expectation is that it gets done.
  • Feedback: We want our employees to flourish, so we regularly provide direct and constructive feedback.

We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 5+ years in QA Automation/SDET roles with proven success leading quality within an Agile team.
  • Programming: Strong proficiency in modern languages essential for automation, specifically C# or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Fintech Expertise: Experience testing complex financial systems (card issuing, transaction processing, or credit risk).
  • Automation Mastery: Hands-on experience with tools for UI (Playwright, Cypress) and API (REST Assured, Other API testing frameworks).
  • Cloud & CI/CD: Familiarity with Azure, Git, and integrating automated testing into deployment workflows.
  • Leadership: Ability to influence without authority, encouraging developers and POs to prioritise automation and quality.

Even if you don’t have all of the necessary skills, we still encourage you to apply.

Interview Process

  • First stage: 30-minute intro, CV review, and values with Talent Partner
  • Second stage: 45-minute “Tech Chat” with Team Manager
  • Final stage: 60-minute Code Pairing + 30-minute Stakeholder Interview with Engineering & Product

Diversity & Inclusion
We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

Great Work Deserves Great Perks

Check out our benefits:

Private Healthcare through AdvanceCare
Anniversary Rewards (€280, €570, €860, 4-week fully paid sabbatical)
Paid Car Parking
️ 36 days holiday (inclusive of public holidays with public holidays carried over if they fall on a weekend)
Annual Learning and Wellbeing Budget
6 free therapy sessions per year
Free drinks and snacks in our offices

Other Info
Check out our ‘Top Tips’ for interviewing.
✔️Keep updated on new job opportunities by following us on Linkedin.
Email careers@capitalontap.com if you have any questions.

Excited to work here? Apply!
If you’d like to progress your career within our fast growing, profitable fintech then click apply and we will aim to get back to you within 3 working days (during busy periods this could take up to 5 working days.)

You will build and improve the WebCompat team’s internal tooling, the dashboards and the broken-site-report screenshot pipeline the team relies on to triage and prioritize site breakage. This is a focused tooling role that makes the WebCompat program faster and more data-driven.

Responsibilities

  • Improve the broken-site-report screenshot capture and pipeline.
  • Work with the WebCompat team (including QA) to turn reporting and triage needs into reliable tooling.

Required qualifications

  • Solid web development (JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python & Django) and experience building dashboards / data views.
  • Comfort with tooling, automation, and web services.

jobs.jobDescription:
We’re Capital on Tap
Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier.

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started!

We opened our first Portuguese office in Porto in autumn 2025, and in less than a year it has grown to a team of 50. Lisbon is the next step. We're opening our first office in the city and looking for engineers to join as founding members of the team, helping shape how we build, hire and work here from day one.

The role starts out fully remote. Once our Lisbon office is open, it will move to a hybrid set-up of two days a week on site.

Salary: €40,000-55,000

This is a multiple-headcount role, so please don't be put off if you've seen it advertised for a while.

What You’ll Be Doing
We’re looking for Full stack Engineers to help us build the best credit card and payment products for small businesses. If you’re looking for an environment where you’re given the freedom to make empowered decisions, research new technologies, and learn/share knowledge with your peers. Then keep on reading!

  • You’ll build robust and scalable solutions using .Net technology
  • From the first line of code to production, monitoring, and continuous improvement - you’ll own the SDLC
  • You’ll craft slick, responsive user interfaces with modern JavaScript frameworks (React), making sure our products don’t just work, they feel great to use
  • Teamwork makes the dream work - you’ll partner with Product Managers, QA’s, and fellow Software Engineers
  • You’ll build bulletproof unit and integration tests to keep our software sharp and our users happy
  • Bugs happen. When they do, you’ll be ready to troubleshoot and tweak as needed
  • You’ll bridge the gap between tech speak and business goals, ensuring everyone’s on the same page and moving forward together

We’re Looking For
Required skills:

  • A minimum of 3+ years hands-on experience in C#, .Net Core, SQL Server, ideally JavaScript and React also!
  • Good testing practices, in both Unit and Integration testing
  • Good understanding of database technologies
  • Experience in using Agile development practices
  • A passion for learning new skills and technologies
  • A proactive, supportive, and collaborative team player

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: C#, .Net, .Net Core
  • Frontend: React, JavaScript
  • Mobile: Flutter, Dart
  • Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
  • Cloud: Azure & GCP

Interview Process

  • First stage: 30-minute intro, CV review, and values with a Talent Partner
  • Second stage: 45-minute “Tech Chat” with a Team Manager
  • Final stage: 90-minute Code Pairing + 30-minute Values Interview

Diversity & Inclusion
We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

Great Work Deserves Great Perks

Check out our benefits:

Private Healthcare through AdvanceCare
Anniversary Rewards (€280, €570, €860, 4-week fully paid sabbatical)

️ 36 days holiday (inclusive of public holidays with public holidays carried over if they fall on a weekend)
Annual Learning and Wellbeing Budget
6 free therapy sessions per year
Free drinks and snacks in our offices

Other Info
Check out our ‘Top Tips’ for interviewing.
✔️Keep updated on new job opportunities by following us on Linkedin.
Email careers@capitalontap.com if you have any questions.

Excited to work here? Apply!
If you’d like to progress your career within our fast growing, profitable fintech then click apply and we will aim to get back to you within 3 working days (during busy periods this could take up to 5 working days.)

jobs.jobDescription:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time to full-time, fully remote Registered Nurses who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across all U.S. states. As an RN in this network, you are often the first clinical touchpoint for members navigating fertility, menopause, hormonal, and metabolic health journeys, providing triage, education, care coordination, and documentation that shape the entire care experience.

All work in this role is performed within RN scope of practice. RNs provide triage, education, care coordination, and documentation; they do not diagnose, do not prescribe, and do not independently modify a treatment plan. Anything requiring clinical judgment beyond RN scope is routed to a physician, so sound escalation judgment is central to the role.

This is a contractor engagement of approximately 20-40 hours per week, with scheduled shifts within the Monday-Friday, 8:00a-6:00p CST coverage window.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Serve as the first clinical reviewer of inbound member messages, triaging for urgency, escalating to a physician when needed, and routing non-clinical threads to the appropriate support team.
  • Deliver member education on menopause staging, hormone therapy, preconception health, metabolic health, and medication administration.
  • Review and triage incoming lab results, escalate critical findings per protocol, retrieve outside records, and coordinate specialist referrals.
  • Manage pharmacy callbacks and prior authorizations in coordination with the care team.
  • Document all clinically relevant interactions same-day, create tracked internal tasks with named owners, and follow established escalation pathways.
  • Maintain active NLC multi-state licensure, complete required credentialing and onboarding, and adhere to HIPAA, continuing education, and liability coverage requirements.
  • Contribute to chart audits and clinical protocol feedback as the telemedicine program scales.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a consistent record of accurate, protocol-aligned triage with appropriate physician escalation and no missed critical lab values.
  • Maintained same-day documentation and timely lab follow-up, with no outstanding credentialing or compliance gaps.
  • Delivered high-quality member education across menopause, preconception, hormone therapy, and metabolic health topics, reflected in strong member experience results.
  • Managed care coordination workflows reliably within your coverage window, including referrals, records retrieval, prior authorizations, and pharmacy callbacks.
  • Contributed to chart audits, protocol feedback, and quality improvement as the telemedicine program scales.

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • An active, unrestricted RN license with NLC (Nurse Licensure Compact) multi-state privileges, in good standing, plus an ADN or BSN from an accredited program (BSN preferred).
  • A minimum of 3 years of active RN clinical experience, with meaningful experience in women's health, reproductive health, OB/GYN, fertility, endocrinology, or menopause care.
  • Demonstrated nurse triage experience, including assessing urgency, applying protocol, escalating appropriately, and recognizing critical lab values.
  • A clear understanding of RN scope of practice and sound judgment about when to escalate.
  • Strong written communication for asynchronous messaging and a strong phone presence for symptom assessment and instruction.
  • Proficiency with EHR and telehealth systems, secure messaging, and e-fax workflows.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and applicable telemedicine privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.
  • The ability to commit to scheduled shifts within the Monday-Friday, 8:00a-6:00p CST coverage window, with a HIPAA-compliant, private home workspace and reliable internet.

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience in a dedicated menopause clinic, fertility center, REI practice, or comparable specialty program.
  • Familiarity with preconception and fertility workup, including AMH and hormone panels, ovulation tracking, and cycle-monitoring labs.
  • Hormone therapy education experience, including prior authorization workflows.
  • Experience supporting members on anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists.
  • Prior experience in digital health, health benefits, or multi-state telemedicine environments.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocol development, quality improvement, or member-facing clinical content.
  • Experience supporting diverse and historically underserved populations, including LGBTQ+ and gender-diverse individuals.
  • Relevant certification (e.g., MSCP through The Menopause Society, RNC-OB) and/or fluency in an additional language.

Why This Role Matters

Carrot's RN network is the front line of the telemedicine clinic. RNs are typically the first clinician a member reaches, and the quality of their triage judgment, education, and follow-through directly determines member safety, trust, and the experience of care during some of the most personal moments of members' lives.

This role also keeps the clinical program running well as it scales. Reliable triage, same-day documentation, and disciplined escalation protect physician capacity for the decisions that require it, while expanding access to guideline-aligned fertility, menopause, and metabolic health support for members who often cannot find it locally.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $40-$50/ hr. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who We Are

Launchpad Technologies Inc. is a global technology partner connecting top talent with high-impact projects across North America and beyond. We specialize in Staff Augmentation and product development, helping companies scale with agility while empowering professionals to grow in meaningful, remote-first environments.

About the Role

Launchpad Technologies is looking for an experienced Senior Implementation Project Manager to join our Professional Services team and lead software implementation projects for international customers. This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who knows how to take ownership of an implementation from kickoff through Go-Live and stabilization, keeping customers, consultants, technical teams, and external partners aligned throughout the process.

You’ll serve as a central point of coordination across multiple stakeholders, managing scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, escalations, and customer expectations while ensuring projects continue moving toward successful delivery.

We’re particularly interested in professionals who have managed software implementations in ERP, financial systems, enterprise applications, or comparable environments. You do not need to be a Functional Consultant or configure the software yourself, but you should understand how software implementation projects work and be comfortable coordinating functional and technical teams.

Start date: September 2026
Contract type: Contractor, Full-Time, 100% Remote
Work hours: Monday to Friday, 7.00 am to 4.00 pm PST

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own software implementation projects from kickoff through Go-Live and post-production stabilization.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and priorities.
  • Act as a primary point of contact for customers throughout project delivery.
  • Coordinate work across Functional Consultants, Technical Consultants, developers, QA resources, customer teams, and third-party partners.
  • Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, blockers, dependencies, and potential delivery impacts.
  • Manage scope changes and ensure their impact on timelines, effort, and deliverables is clearly understood and communicated.
  • Lead customer status meetings and maintain clear, consistent stakeholder communication.
  • Manage customer expectations and facilitate escalations when projects encounter challenges.
  • Drive accountability for actions, decisions, deliverables, and follow-ups across project stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with shared resources while balancing priorities across different engagements.
  • Support successful handover following Go-Live and stabilization.

What You Need to Succeed

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of Project Management experience, with substantial experience managing software implementation projects.
  • Proven ownership of projects across the implementation lifecycle, from planning/kickoff through Go-Live.
  • Strong experience managing scope, timelines, milestones, risks, dependencies, changes, and deliverables.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong customer-facing experience, including status communication, expectation management, difficult conversations, and escalations.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and prioritize effectively in a dynamic delivery environment.
  • Strong collaboration and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to remain composed, pragmatic, and solution-oriented when projects encounter pressure or ambiguity.
  • Advanced English for leading meetings and communicating independently with international customers.

Nice-to-haves

  • Project Management experience within ERP, Finance, Accounting, enterprise software, or Professional Services implementations.
  • Familiarity with financial software implementation environments.
  • Experience working with distributed or international delivery teams.
  • PMP, Scrum, Agile, or other Project Management certifications.

A specific ERP, financial platform, certification, or academic degree is not required. We care primarily about demonstrated software implementation delivery experience and strong Project Management judgment.

Our Recruitment Process

Here’s what to expect from our candidate-friendly interview process. Our goal is to keep the process focused, transparent, and respectful of your time, while giving both sides enough space to determine whether there’s a strong mutual fit.

  1. Initial Interview – Talent Acquisition (60 minutes): A conversation focused on your implementation Project Management experience, project ownership, customer-facing responsibilities, collaboration style, English communication skills, and career goals. We’ll also provide full details about the opportunity and working conditions.

  2. Final Interview – Hiring Manager (60 minutes): A deeper discussion with Professional Services leadership focused on your Project Management expertise, delivery experience, judgment, communication, and approach to leading software implementations.

Why Join Launchpad?

We believe that great work starts with great people. At Launchpad, we offer:

  • Fully remote work with hardware provided
  • Global team experience with clients in North America
  • USD 3800-4200 monthly compensation
  • Training and learning stipends
  • Paid Time Off (vacation, personal, study)
  • ‍♂️ A culture that values autonomy, purpose, and human connection

Compliance & Equal Opportunity

Launchpad is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable laws in Canada and British Columbia.

All candidate information will be handled confidentially and used solely for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy regulations.

Ready to make your mark? Apply now and be part of something exciting!

jobs.jobDescription:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for Full-Stack engineers to develop and maintain both front-end and back-end components of our product suite.

Your general responsibilities will include:

  • Building and maintaining the front-ends for our platform and products, which are built on top of our cutting-edge voice models and used by millions of users.

  • High degrees of ownership. You will be responsible for shipping end-to-end features across the front and back ends of our stack, as well as helping set the direction of the features and products you're working on.

  • Collaborating closely with others on the Engineering, Growth and Sales teams to understand, and design solutions for, our customer and internal team’s most important problems and workflows.

We believe in pairing engineers with work that matches their strengths and interests. This means that there is significant flexibility in staffing engineers across the company.

Specific responsibilities might include:

  • Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break-throughs. This could involve making sweeping UX changes, adding significant functionality, or building integrations with other common consumer/enterprise solutions.

  • Designing & developing clean, intuitive, and functional user interfaces for products that will be used by millions of users and the world’s largest enterprises.

  • Working with internal teams and customers directly to synthesize feedback, understand user’s issues, and then design improvements and features to solve them.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. We do require:

  • Experience with Web Development using Typescript/React

  • Familiarity with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions, data structures etc.

  • Interest in UI/UX design

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.jobDescription:
Senior Strategic Implementation Specialist

Hi! I’m Morgan, the Manager of Strategic Implementations here at Ashby. Our customers are at the center of everything we do, and that’s especially true during implementation. We take pride in being responsive, collaborative partners who focus not just on delivery, but on doing things thoughtfully. This role plays a critical part in ensuring our new customers start off with a strong foundation and a clear path forward. I’m thrilled to be hiring our next Implementation Specialist. As part of our growing Professional Services team within Ashby’s Customer Success organization, you’ll play a key role early in the customer journey—ultimately helping to elevate the entire customer experience.

About this role:

As our Implementation Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and executing the end-to-end implementation of Ashby’s solution for many of our new customers. You will work directly with customers in our Strategic (predominantly Enterprise) segment, developing and executing implementation plans to ensure a positive customer experience and expedited time to value. Your goal is to support our customers, helping them get up and running swiftly with Ashby so they can achieve their desired outcomes.

Role requirements:

  • Implementation & Project Management: You have extensive experience managing and executing several complex implementation and onboarding projects concurrently in a high-growth B2B SaaS org (defining the work, aligning with stakeholders, communicating the project plan, and ultimately delivering results in accordance with the agreed-upon expectations). You keep the team on track to ensure milestones are met. You work effectively in a remote-first setting, with the ability to travel <10% as needed for strategic customer engagements.

  • Technical Proficiency: You have a strong understanding of complex, configurable B2B SaaS products and their technical intricacies. By "complex", we mean platforms with multi-step workflows, supporting several core workflows, and integrations with other systems. You're technically curious and creative. Ashby or ATS experience is a plus, not required.

  • Customer Centricity: You are adept at understanding customer needs and tailoring implementations to meet their specific requirements. You build strong customer relationships by maintaining high levels of engagement and communication; you’re the customer’s proactive guide and advocate throughout the implementation period.

  • Change Management: You are experienced in navigating change management processes and helping customers adapt to new systems and a refreshed approach.

  • Best Practices & Recommendations: You take pride in advising customers on best practices specific to their usage of software to ensure optimal value.

  • Critical Thinking & Solutions Orientation: You proactively address thematic customer opportunities and improve our processes accordingly. You don’t rely on ‘I’ve seen this done,’ but instead think critically to solve problems.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: You effectively partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations to align and define progress.

You could be a great fit if:

  • You demonstrate clear communication. You ask clarifying questions with precision and can distill complex concepts into simple themes.

  • You are a great listener. You see your role as the voice of the customer to internal stakeholders so we can ensure that our offerings continue to evolve in accordance with customer needs.

  • You are a problem solver. You thrive at solving complex challenges with innovative, scalable solutions.

  • ⚡️You know process matters. You are eager to improve processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and efficacy.

  • Your peers describe you as detail-oriented and technically proficient. You take pride in internal operations.

  • You are data-driven. You use metrics and analytics to inform decisions and measure success.

  • You are adaptable. You can navigate changes in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • ‍ You love to coach. You see every teaching moment as an opportunity and are excited to help our customers grow.

You might not be a great fit if:

  • You prefer an in-person role over remote.

  • You are less interested in customer-facing roles that require both technical and interpersonal skills.

  • You are accustomed to defining ideas and strategies, yet not responsible for their execution.

  • You prefer working with a simple product (such as a point solution).

  • You prefer exclusively to build (rather than build, iterate, optimize).

Our Philosophy

Here are a few key points (relevant to the go-to-market side) that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is a lot easier to sell.

  • We want to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people (and the right work environment) deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We hire and compensate accordingly.

  • We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process.

The Interview

At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. Our interview process is structured to get to know you and your career as well as empower you with insight into our key focus areas. Here is the process in its entirety:

  • 30 min - Recruiter Screen with Talent Team

  • 45 min - Interview with Morgan (Hiring Manager) + Head of Professional Services

  • 60 min- Mock Call with 2 Implementation Specialists

  • Final Round:

    • 30 min - Customer Adoption with Head of Dedicated Customer Success & one of our Strategic CSMs

    • 30 min - Interview with VP of Customer Success

    • 10 min - Closing Questions with Hiring Manager

Benefits

  • You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.

  • You get to sell a product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about.

  • Competitive compensation is offered.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks is recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it

  • Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for back-end engineers to expand the functionality of our system. There is flexibility in staffing engineers on projects across the company, depending on the project, your specific responsibilities might include:

  • Building and maintaining our platform on top of our cutting-edge voice models, which are used by millions of users.

  • Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break-throughs. This could involve adding significant functionality, or building integrations with other common consumer/enterprise solutions.

  • Maintaining and strengthening our internal infrastructure as we scale and grow to ensure that our products remain live, performant and secure.

  • Collaborating closely with engineers and others from the Frontend, Growth and Sales teams to understand, and design solutions for our customers.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, or GitHub contributions. We do require:

  • Expertise in Python.

  • A strong background in backend development.

  • Familiarity with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions, data structures etc.

  • Knowledge about test design and security fundamentals.

  • Bonus:

    • Experience with Kubernetes.

    • Experience with Stripe or other payment processing providers.

    • Basics about how AI models work.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.jobDescription:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary
We are looking for a Global Support Engineer I who can support a remote-first, flexible shift schedule. This is a growth role—you will advance your career as a support engineering professional while simultaneously increasing your knowledge and hands-on experience with networking infrastructure as a service. You will regularly support interesting and challenging technical matters and questions and bring clarity to our customers as they leverage our tools to secure their networks in an ever-changing security threat landscape.

Key Responsibilities
As a member of the Global Support Engineering team, you will work with customers to resolve technical issues with our product(s) using a variety of internal resources and provide data analysis to understand and troubleshoot systems. Your day-to-day responsibilities could include any of the following:

  • Provide hardware and firmware deployment support for our appliances.
  • Actively participate in Knowledge Centered Services (KCS) by learning from documented knowledge and contributing to discussions.
  • Engage in troubleshooting activities, following guidance and existing documentation.
  • Assist with the initial stages of ticket handling and escalate when necessary.
  • Work collaboratively with more experienced engineers and cross functional teams to gain deeper insights into complex issues.
  • Assist customers with configuration of network infrastructure, virtualization, and third-party integrations.
  • Assist customers with hardware support and replacement.
  • Utilize a ticketing system to update, communicate, and move work items to completion.
  • Act as the single point of contact for customer questions and concerns.
  • Communicate with customers in a highly professional manner via various channels including phone, ticketing system, and video conferencing.
  • Pair your existing knowledge with a continuous learning mindset to elevate your service to our customers while being a force-multiplier to your colleagues.
  • Attend regular “in-office” meetings (limited to no more than monthly) and annual in-office training sessions

Required Qualifications

  • Two years of experience in B2B Technical Support — this is not an entry-level position.
  • In-depth knowledge of the OSI model.
  • Understanding of network infrastructure routing and switching concepts.
  • In-depth knowledge of data traversal within an internal environment and its interaction with external networks.
  • Specific networking knowledge related to protocols, DHCP, TCP, DNS resolution, TLS and TLS connection establishment, HTTP, SSO, network topologies, etc.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into applicable troubleshooting best practices.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex architectural incidents based on the application or incident.
  • Excellent customer service, organizational, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work cooperatively with others within the organization and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Ability to work well in fast-paced, high-stress environments.
  • Predictable, reliable attendance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Unix/Linux-based operating systems.
  • An understanding of cybersecurity concepts, terminology and tools
  • Javascript familiarity and comfort.
  • Certifications in networking or infrastructure (like CompTIA Network+).
  • Certifications in Cyber Security (like CompTia Security+)

Schedule: 9am-6pm

The salary range for this role is £30,000 - £35,000 + bonus

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time
  • Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan
  • FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
  • Educational Reimbursement
  • 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
  • Pet Insurance (US Only)
  • Parental Leave (US Only)
  • Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

Create a Job Alert

Interested in building your career at ExtraHop? Get future opportunities sent straight to your email.
