About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types

Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role:

As a Data Analyst in our Business Intelligence organization, you will turn operational and customer data into actionable reports and dashboards that drive business decisions. You will partner directly with internal business teams, such as sales compensation, to gather reporting requirements, document technical specifications, and build user friendly data assets.

Your primary hands-on work will involve writing SQL views and building dashboards directly within Databricks using data populated by our engineering team. A key aspect of this role is context engineering, where you will add structured descriptions and metadata to tables, views, and columns so that our data is easily discoverable and accurately queried by AI tools like Claude. Additionally, you will validate report accuracy, monitor data quality, and maintain documentation of your reporting logic to ensure long-term reliability.

Your Opportunity:

  • You will have the opportunity to build and scale the business reporting layer within Databricks.
  • You will be part of a globally distributed team of data professionals.
  • This role is designed for someone who wants to grow their analytical skills in a collaborative, business facing environment.
  • Leverage modern AI coding agents, such as Databricks' Genie or Claude, to assist in writing and optimizing your queries.

What You'll Need:

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in a business intelligence, reporting, or data analyst role.
  • To be considered for this role, you must meet one of the following criteria: Hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Columbia, MD office three days a week, or hybrid schedule with the ability to commute to our Boston, MA office three days a week.
  • Fundamental working proficiency in SQL, including an understanding of select statements, order of operations, joins, aggregations, and filtering.
  • Basic to working proficiency with Databrick, a comparable lakehouse, or cloud data platform such as Snowflake.
  • Experience building dashboards and presenting data visually using tools like Databricks native dashboards, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical business stakeholders and translate them into usable data assets.
  • A detail oriented mindset with comfort in documenting data objects, definitions, and logic for downstream users.

And Ideally:

  • Prior experience writing table and column descriptions or metadata to support data catalogs, semantic layers, or natural language query tools.
  • Exposure to Python or PySpark within Databricks notebooks, which will give you a significant advantage for career progression on this specific team.
  • Familiarity with analytics engineering practices, such as dbt, or version control systems like Git.
  • Experience working in enterprise software, SaaS, or cybersecurity environments.

#LI-Hybrid #LI-LP1

Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, location and experience, and may fall outside of the range shown. Employees are also eligible for variable compensation in addition to base pay (commission for sales roles, bonus for non-sales roles), depending on company and individual performance. jobs.jobDescription:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role

As a Senior Product Designer at RevenueCat, you’ll own complex product problems from discovery through production. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering to understand customers, identify opportunities, shape what we build and why, and turn technically complex workflows into simple, polished experiences for developers.

You’ll join a small design team with a high bar for interaction and visual craft. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, talks directly to customers, prototypes and iterates quickly, and stays involved until the work is shipped and working well in production.

About you

  • You have a strong track record solving complex product problems in B2B, SaaS, developer tools, or similarly complex environments.

  • You can frame ambiguous problems, identify opportunities, make sound trade-offs, and help shape what gets built and why.

  • You design clear, intuitive workflows and think carefully about information architecture, states, edge cases, errors, and interactions.

  • You have a high visual craft bar and care deeply about hierarchy, typography, spacing, composition, and polish.

  • You stay close to customers, using direct conversations and qualitative and quantitative evidence to inform your decisions.

  • You work closely with Product and Engineering, involve partners early, reduce scope intelligently, and stay engaged through implementation and follow-up.

  • You communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous environment and take ownership beyond the boundaries of a design handoff.

  • You understand technical constraints well enough to make realistic decisions and are comfortable using prototypes, code, or modern AI tools when they help you learn or move faster.

  • You are excited about our mission to help developers make more money.

In the first month, you'll

  • Get to know our product, customers, and teams.

  • Familiarize yourself with our design system and visual language.

  • Talk to some customers to understand their needs.

  • Start engaging in discovery and design for your first meaningful project.

Within the first 3 months, you'll

  • Have taken full ownership of all design aspects for your cross-functional product team.

  • Have seen the first project shipped that you worked on from ideation to launch.

  • Work with your team to discover opportunities and solutions to deliver value to our customers.

Within the first 6 months, you'll

  • Be an integral product partner within your cross-functional team, helping shape priorities and product direction.

  • Raise the bar for interaction and visual craft within your area while contributing patterns and improvements that benefit the broader product.

  • Contribute to the development of the design practice at RevenueCat through critique, shared patterns, and collaboration with the rest of the design team.

Within the first 12 months, you'll

  • Have shipped meaningful product improvements end to end, from identifying the opportunity through implementation and iteration.

  • Help improve reusable patterns, systems, and ways of working that make the design team more effective without adding unnecessary process.

  • Be a strong advocate for customer understanding, product quality, and thoughtful design across RevenueCat.

What we offer:

  • Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

  • 10-year window to exercise vested equity options

  • A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

  • 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

  • Paid desk at a co-working space

  • Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat, including tips to help you succeed.

More on how we work:

  • How we think about hiring and team design: Building a Winning Team

  • The values that guide how we work: Our Values

  • How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat

  • What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations

  • What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world’s largest Ads Rating Programs and we want you to join!

As an Ads Quality Rater, you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users. In other words, you’ll tell the AI program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user’s keywords.

You will review ads in both English and Cantonese

This role is great for people who:

- Surf the internet daily

- Use major search engines frequently

- Know what people want based on a few keywords

- Enjoy researching topics online

- Want a flexible and fun side job

Project Details

Job Title: Ads Quality Rater

Pay Rate: Based on tasks (approximately $13 per hour)

Location: Remote/work from home - must be based in Hong Kong

Hours: Set your schedule based on the following – Minimum commitment is 5 hours per week. You can choose to work up to 20 hours per week.

Start Date: ASAP

Employment Type: Independent Contractor/Freelance/Self-Employed

Project Duration: Long-term

Note:

- Even though the position is WFH, you must reside in the country that is noted in this description. This will be automatically checked during the hiring process.

Recruitment Process

- There is no formal interview for this job! No phone calls, no waiting, and no wasting time wondering whether you got the job or not.

- Instead, you will be guided through a self-paced and automated recruitment process.

IMPORTANT NOTE: Welo Data uses numerous identity checks to ensure that everyone who makes the team is real, qualified, and ready to work. To avoid any misunderstandings, do not use IP masking programs (such as VPNs).

Experience & Requirements 

  • Fluency in Cantonese
  • Strong understanding of English (written and spoken)

  • Reliable computer system and internet connection
  • Familiar with using online search engines
  • Sign a standard Non-Disclosure Agreement and Service Level Agreement

Compensation

Additional Information

Please note that this work is based on project needs. Due to this, weekly hours may vary and flexibility with change is expected. You must legally be able to work on freelance projects in Hong Kong.

Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Your Role:

Tenable is seeking a Country Manager responsible for leading a regional sales team of highly skilled, seasoned sales individuals. The Country Manager will map the course, develop the vision and implement annual plans and is accountable for delivering measurable results that achieves and exceeds revenue and margin targets.

Your Opportunity:

  • Act as the front line manager to recruit the direct sales management team and ensure, in turn, that these managers effectively recruit, hire, develop, and manage a tiered sales team
  • Accurately manage, inspect and report in a predictable manner on all aspects of pipeline development and forecasts for the region
  • Split time 50/50 between managing a team and customer interfacing calls
  • Works closely with new as well as established channel partners to generate new business opportunities
  • Develop go to market plan for the specific region
  • Lead negotiations for large complex deals
  • Work closely with leadership for other functions such as Sales Engineering, Channel, finance, legal, R&D and marketing to ensure efficient alignment to regional activities and to enable optimum sales performance
  • Direct sales responsibility for accounts in region and attain revenue goal for new product sales
  • Initiate, establish and maintain contact with team members, prospects, clients, and partners within assigned territory
  • Develop recommendations for growth, opportunities for growth, and key target accounts in the assigned territory
  • Develop and maintain a complete knowledge of Tenable’s products

What You'll Need:

  • 10+ years of Director-level management experience of direct reports in a fast paced, highly competitive, ever-changing sales environment
  • Minimum 6 years’ experience selling Security Products: Vulnerability Management, Continuous Monitoring, IDS/IPS, SIEM, DLP, Compliance, Encryption, access Management, Authentication, etc.
  • Strong knowledge and understanding of how to sell multi-product software solutions
  • Minimum of 8+ years in quota carrying sales role with demonstrated success
  • Extensive experience negotiating large complex deals with extremely complex terms, conditions, price pressures and considerations
  • Proven track record working with channel and technology partners to build strategic and cooperative sales campaigns together

jobs.jobDescription:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

What We’re Looking For

As Datavant scales, Jira and the broader Atlassian ecosystem increasingly underpin how teams coordinate work, manage services, connect systems, and provide visibility across the organization. As our Atlassian Platform Architect, you will own the technical direction, architecture, health, and evolution of Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and the broader Atlassian ecosystem.

This is a senior, hands-on role combining enterprise architecture with deep technical delivery. You will define the target architecture, roadmap, governance, data and integration standards, while personally designing and implementing complex automations, integrations, workflows, reporting, and service management solutions.

You will lead platform remediation and transformation, reduce technical debt, and ensure the environment remains secure, resilient, scalable, and maintainable. You will also serve as the senior technical partner to our Jira administration team, setting the standards they work to and taking ownership of changes requiring deeper architecture or engineering expertise.

What You Will Do

  • Define and maintain the target architecture, technical strategy and prioritized roadmap for Jira, JSM, Confluence and the wider Atlassian ecosystem.
  • Establish enterprise standards for data models, workflows, schemes, fields, permissions, automation, integrations, reporting and naming conventions.
  • Take ownership of platform health and lead the remediation of configuration sprawl, technical debt, duplicate objects and inconsistent platform patterns.
  • Design and implement complex solutions using Jira Automation, Rovo, ScriptRunner, REST APIs, webhooks and Marketplace applications.
  • Define JSM and ITSM architecture supporting service requests, incidents, problems, changes, knowledge and asset management.
  • Establish integration standards covering APIs, identity systems, authentication, data ownership, monitoring, error handling and recovery.
  • Define security, privacy, availability, recoverability, performance, data-retention and audit requirements.
  • Introduce architecture reviews, change controls and lifecycle-management processes that protect the platform while supporting delivery.
  • Lead major platform remediation, consolidation, migration, redesign and integration initiatives.
  • Evaluate Marketplace applications and emerging Atlassian capabilities, including Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo, based on security, privacy, cost and maintainability.
  • Partner with IT, Security, Privacy, Compliance, Enterprise Systems, Product and Engineering to translate requirements into sustainable technical solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership to Jira administrators by reviewing complex changes, establishing reusable patterns, mentoring the team and taking ownership of high-risk work.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for architectural issues, significant platform risks and complex technical decisions.
  • Support licensing, application rationalization, vendor decisions and platform investment planning.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 6-8 years experience leading Jira and the Atlassian ecosystem within a large or complex organisation.
  • Deep hands-on Jira Cloud and JSM expertise across workflows, schemes, custom fields, permissions, automation, security and project configuration.
  • Strong technical experience with Forge, REST APIs, webhooks, workflow extensions and enterprise integrations.
  • Experience defining enterprise architecture, platform governance, configuration standards, technical roadmaps and reusable design patterns.
  • Experience designing JSM and ITSM solutions aligned with ITIL practices and an enterprise IT operating model.
  • Strong knowledge of Atlassian Cloud identity and security, including Atlassian Guard, SAML, SSO, SCIM, provisioning and access controls.
  • Direct experience working with both HIPAA and FedRAMP requirements and translating them into practical platform controls.
  • Experience assessing platform health and leading remediation, migration, consolidation or transformation initiatives.
  • Experience evaluating and governing Marketplace applications and other Atlassian extensions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to move confidently between strategy, technical design, hands-on delivery and team mentoring.
  • A willingness to take ownership of a challenging environment, make clear technical decisions and drive issues through to resolution.
